title: This Animal Weighs a Soda Can and Hunts Rabbits
subject: stoat

scenes.text: This animal weighs about as much as a soda can. It hunts rabbits.
It's a stoat. Rabbits can be five times its size, and some sources say ten.
So it doesn't just chase. It dances, weaving, leaping and tumbling in the open field.
Watching rabbits seem almost mesmerised, and the stoat creeps closer.
Or it tracks one rabbit by scent and runs until it seizes up from exhaustion and fear.
Then it leaps onto the neck. Whether the dance is a trick or an illness, nobody is sure.

description:
A stoat weighs about 200 to 400 grams, yet it hunts rabbits several times its size.
It either dances to mesmerise them or chases one by scent until it freezes with exhaustion.
Have you ever seen a stoat?
first_comment: Would you bet on the stoat or the rabbit? Tell me which animal I should cover next.
